A. Dubovskaya, C.B. Pena & **D.J.P. O'Sullivan** (2025).
[Modeling diffusion in networks with communities: A multitype branching process approach](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevE.111.034310).
*Physical Review E*, 111(3), 034310.

A multitype branching process framework for modelling how information and behaviour diffuse through networks with community structure, extending our earlier work to capture the interplay between diffusion dynamics and mesoscale network organisation.

[[{{< ai arxiv >}}  arXiv paper link](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.04456){.tag .tag-icon}]{.pub-tags}
::::

  Authors (Year). [Title](DOI link). *Journal*, vol(issue), pages. [Open Access]{.badge}

  BADGES — honours/status, placed inline after the citation, e.g. [Open Access]{.badge}:
    Open Access · Editors' Suggestion · Invited special issue · Featured on journal homepage
    (add new wording as needed — any short phrase works with the .badge class)

  TAGS — clickable extras, placed in one .pub-tags line below the entry.
  Every tag should have an icon where a sensible one exists: pair {.tag .tag-icon}
  with an inline icon in the link text. Icons come from two sources already
  loaded by the site — academicons (`{{< ai NAME >}}`, e.g. arxiv, orcid,
  google-scholar) and Bootstrap Icons (`<i class="bi bi-NAME"></i>`, the same
  set used for the navbar's GitHub/email icons). Find icon names at
  https://icons.getbootstrap.com. Current conventions used on this page:

    arXiv          {{< ai arxiv >}}                      preprint
    Code           <i class="bi bi-github"></i>          GitHub repo
    Code           <i class="bi bi-code-slash"></i>      non-GitHub code/model archive (e.g. CoMSES)
    Open data      <i class="bi bi-database"></i>        dataset archive — Zenodo, UK Data Service ReShare, OSF, Figshare, etc.
    Paper link    <i class="bi bi-patch-check"></i>     open peer review history / decision letter
                   (PLOS journals publish this by default — link to the article page)
    Press release  <i class="bi bi-newspaper"></i>       university / EurekAlert / funder press release
    News article   <i class="bi bi-newspaper"></i>       e.g. "The Times"
    Blog post      <i class="bi bi-chat-square-text"></i> e.g. "ECMI blog", outreach writing
    Radio/podcast  <i class="bi bi-mic"></i>              e.g. "Radio interview"

  If nothing above fits, a plain [Label](url){.tag} with no icon (just the
  outbound arrow) is perfectly fine — don't force a mismatched icon.

  IMPORTANT: only add a tag if you have a real, verified URL for it — never
  invent or guess a link (arXiv IDs, GitHub usernames, and press URLs are all
  easy to get subtly wrong, and a wrong link is worse than no tag).
